title: Lunch at the Small Cafe
text:
Today we go to a small cafe. The menu has soup, bread, rice and fish. Ana wants soup. Tom wants fish and water.

The soup costs three dollars. The fish costs eight dollars. Water is free. Ana and Tom pay at the table.

questions.text: How much does the soup cost?
What is probably true about Tom?
options: He does not want to drink

questions.text: What can we say about the cafe?
options: It is a very expensive restaurant
It is a simple place with a short menu
It is open for breakfast only

vocabulary.definition: a list of the food and drinks that a restaurant or cafe offers
a hot liquid food made from vegetables, meat or fish

paragraph_translations: Hoy vamos a una cafetería pequeña. El menú tiene sopa, pan, arroz y pescado. Ana quiere sopa. Tom quiere pescado y agua.
La sopa cuesta tres dólares. El pescado cuesta ocho dólares. El agua es gratis. Ana y Tom pagan en la mesa.
